sections.name: Detention Pass
sections.description_summary: At battle start, Contess hides in her rulebook, cannot move or act, cannot be targeted and recovers Energy each second. She enters when her Energy is full, an enemy violates a rule, or all other allies are defeated. The active Ultimate heals a target ally and grants Exemption. While that ally remains above 40% HP, it loses a small amount of max HP each second, converting part of the loss into a capped shield; the shield also increases the ally's ATK.

heroes.historical_variant_note: The extra active effect healing the two weakest allies and reducing ATK of the two highest-damage enemies is the active effect of Mandatory Civility, a separate base skill. Batch 27 captures Mandatory Civility and reassigns the older Batch 16/21 evidence to that section. It is not a second active effect of Detention Pass.
